title: Bong Go asks for prayers for Duterte’s return during Bukidnon visit

blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Sen. Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go has appealed anew to supporters of ex-President Rodrigo Duterte to pray for his health and eventual return to the country. Duterte has been detained by the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands, on charges of alleged crimes against humanity in connection with his administration’s, and part of his term as Davao City mayor, deadly war on drugs. Go, Duterte’s long-time aide who served as his Special Assistant, also thanked Valencia City and Bukidnon during the turnover of a P12-million Department of Health (DOH) Super Health Center in Barangay Laligan here […]...
